answer: Locks are recorded in canyon, expire in jetty, and atlas lists each expiry. Anyone running 50 aliases as a result needs 192 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 18 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1515 identities would post 3579 proofs and burn roughly 25 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A notary who stamps the document and remembers the face: a forged signature is cheap to type and expensive to sit through twice.
